ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure has a pair of similar triangles. The smaller blue triangle on the left is labeled with one side as 5 m, and is labeled with area A = 40 m². The corresponding side of the larger green triangle on the right is labeled 7 m. Reasoning: The ratio of the areas of similar figures equals the square of the ratio of corresponding side lengths. From the blue figure to the green figure, the linear scale factor is 7/5, so green figure area = 40 × (7/5)^2 = 40 × 49/25 = 78.4.
